Gurugram Biker Incident: Accused Denies Intentional Hit, Police Detail Allegations

A woman biker in Gurugram claims she was intentionally targeted in a hit-and-run incident. The accused, identified as Bainsla, denies deliberately hitting her. Police allege that Bainsla hurled slurs at the woman and attempted to escape custody following the incident. The specific details of the confrontation and the extent of the woman's injuries were not detailed in the coverage.
